category_title: Middle school students with severe reading disabilities who disengage from traditional tasks
minimal_context: The student is using an iPad to complete an assigned task that will be shared on a large screen with the class.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We have a tight timeline today. Please use your iPad to complete the assigned task so we can share it on the large screen with the rest of the class.

STUDENT: (Looks at the iPad) Yeah, I know we have to share it on the screen.

TUTOR: How is your progress coming along?

STUDENT: (Opens the web browser) I'm just checking something online real quick.

TUTOR: Make sure you keep working on the assignment.

STUDENT: (Ignores the assignment and continues searching the Internet for items off-task, scrolling through unrelated websites)

options.A: Compromise, negotiate, and share decision-making power with the student instead of imposing control.
options.B: Gradually fade support and transfer responsibility for the assigned iPad tasks to the student.
options.C: Implement a personalized intervention focused on instructing a replacement behavior with relevant reinforcers.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the assigned iPad tasks.
